# Generated print assets

These images are original, text-free illustrations generated for the golden
fixture corpus. The HTML fixtures provide all titles, labels, and copy so the
rendered text remains deterministic and searchable in PDF output.

The `*-page.png` and `*-print.png` files are fixed crops derived from the
generated source art for stable page-sized image frames.

## Fonts

Print fixtures do **not** bundle third-party font files here. They use CSS
generic families (`sans-serif`, `serif`, `monospace`). The converter embeds
its built-in free default faces for those generics (see project `LICENSE` and
`documentation/fonts.md`).
